snippet.title: The Cursed Garden – The Official Trailer - Free Indie Horror Game (itch.io)
snippet.description:
Game : https://deaddove-studio.itch.io/the-cursed-garden
itch io : https://deaddove-studio.itch.io/

About the game

I was an ordinary caretaker of a quiet garden, routine nights, sounds of nature, and nothing to worry about...

Until he came that night.

Strange sounds, shadows moving on their own, and symbols carved into trees that never existed before.

The calm turned into a nightmare. And the garden...is no longer what it was.

In this game, you will enter the heart of darkness, where you will discover that there is a satanic organization that has begun its secret rituals inside the garden.
